column1: # every check CI runs on a pull request or a push to main, and the local
# tier of tool/tasks/fullcheck.sh that runs the same command, or why none
# can. read by tool/tests/test_gatematch.py, which fails when a step of
# gatecheck.yml or lintworks.yml has no line here, a line names a CI step
# that is gone, a local step is not a step of a tier it names, or a command
# of an `exact` line is not in the tier's source (tool/tasks/tiersteps.sh,
# tool/tasks/fullcheck.sh; `python X` there is `"$PY" X`, and a pip install
# is the environment, not the check). rehearsal.yml and cleanhost.yml are
# listed where a local equivalent or a mitigation exists.
# columns: workflow, job, step (its name, else its id or action, else its
# first command), tiers (quick, push, full, space-separated, or -), local
# (the step name in those tiers; `report` is the skip table every tier ends
# with, `pinmode` fullcheck's refusal of PIN_HNSW_DIGESTS), match, note.
# match: exact (the same commands), equiv (the same check in another form,
# the note says how), setup (the job's environment, the note says where the
# local one comes from), none (no local run: the note gives the reason and
# the mitigation; local and tiers then name the step that mitigates, if any).
# the one intentional difference: the push tier sets URNA_TEST_REDUCED=1,
# so the two 10k-vector hnsw builds and the txt_streams property run on
# fewer cases there; CI and the full tier's release test run them whole.
